Gadgeteer Class Archetype.text:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-features.E9NE0VrzJbb9Gra4]{Gadgeteer Innovation}

You find the idea of dedicating your brilliance to a single invention is an ineffective path to discovery. After all, does it not take failure to create success? Iterative and expansive test cases in constructing gadgets; that is the means by which you choose to measure your successes and failures.

You can create gadgets that do not become permanently broken, even allowing your temporary gadgets to survive under the right conditions.

New Innovations.name: New Innovations
New Innovations.text:
An inventors innovation represents their lifes work, not necessarily in its capabilities, but in the culmination of their rigorous attempts to shape the world around them. No different than an appendage, an innovation is the extension of the inventor themselves, exerting their will on the world and those around them. An idea is merely an innovation locked within the confines of the mind, and where they lack the necessary proclivities to exert themselves on reality, an inventor makes good on their true purpose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-features.e5Gp4AYOwf4Uux7I]{Healing Innovation}

Your innovation is a piece of medical genius; a machine that allows you to treat patients instantly. Your innovation is 1 Bulk and it functions as a martial one-handed melee weapon. When you first gain your healing innovation, you choose its form to be a 1d6 bludgeoning damage with the shove trait in the club group or a 1d4 piercing damage with the agile and finesse traits in the knife group. Sufficiently advanced science is indistinguishable from magic. You have engineered a device capable of casting spells or interacting with the arcane through mechanical means. You can cast arcane spells, and your innovation contains the data of four common arcane cantrips. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two arcane cantrips each day. You use your inventor class proficiency for your spell DCs and spell attack rolls you gained from the magitek innovation. You become trained in Arcana and your spellcasting attribute modifier for inventor spells is Intelligence. Your modifications and actions you gain from the magitek innovation also have the arcane trait in addition to any traits they would normally have. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-spells.rLpTFGCUUdXtUbaL]{Technomancy Ray} focus cantrip.

Your magitek innovation is an object of your design that weighs 1 Bulk and must be worn, held, or wielded to be able to use your unstable actions and to Cast technomancy ray.

When you use Overdrive, you do not apply the normal effects for your Overdrive on Strikes, but instead apply the effects of Overdrive to spell attack rolls that deal damage, have no duration, and target a single creature.

You can only apply the damage from your overdrive once if your spell would deal damage more than once to the same creature. If you gain Overdrive Ally or similar effects that would provide Overdrive’s effects to allies, your allies still only apply effects of Overdrive to their Strikes.

Unconventions.name: Unconventions
Unconventions.text:
The birth of innovation is pursuing alternatives, and inventors are always seeking to push the limits of what is possible. While some may regard them as unconventional, they prove effective and derive results nonetheless.

When you first become an inventor, you can choose to gain an Unconvention. When you select an Unconvention, you lose the Overdrive and Explode Inventor class features and gain the listed class features instead. When you gain additional damage from Expert Overdrive, Master Overdrive, and Legendary Overdrive, you instead increase the damage you deal from the listed action. When using the listed actions, or any time your innovation explodes on a critical failure and damages you, change the damage type from fire damage to the type of damage used for your Overdrive’s replacement. If a feat or ability would use or require the use of Overdrive or Explode, you instead use your Unconventions replacement for any effects or prerequisites for those actions.

If you take Variable Core or Variable Gadgetry class feats, you add fire to the possible choices for damage types instead of the damage type that corresponds to your Unconvention’s unstable action if those feats include its damage type as a choice. In addition, if you gain an ability that deals fire damage from an inventor class feature or class feat, you instead deal the damage associated with the unstable action you gained from your choice of Unconvention.

When under the effects of a replacement for Overdrive, you can still use the replacement action. You can't extend your replacement Overdrive’s duration this way, but you can turn a replacement overdrive into a critical replacement overdrive if you critically succeed. A failure has no effect on your current replacement Overdrive, and you end your Overdrive on a critical failure.

Unconventional Variable Cores: Variable Core is a key class feat that alters the way several inventor abilities function, such as the damage of Explode and the various Explode replacements of the Unconventions. While an inventor that does not use an unconvention might select a variable core of cold and produce a thermodynamic modulation core, an inventor that combines a polarity unconvention and fire damage might be the result of a magnetic friction oscillator. The unique combinations of Variable Core possible with the unconventions encourages inventor players to decide how their own unconvention might function in combination with a variable core, and where applicable, may cause altered effects. These altered effects are often specified, but players and GMs can work together to come up with new ideas on how these different combinations interact.

Suggested Changes.name: Suggested Changes
Suggested Changes.text:
Unstable Changes

Add the following sentence to the end of the first paragraph of Unstable:

“The flat check for unstable is reduced by 4 for each unstable action you have access to beyond 1, reducing it to a minimum of DC 9 once you possess three unstable actions. After you roll a success the flat check for an action with the unstable trait, the flat check for unstable increases by 4 to a maximum flat check of DC 17. If you get a critical success on your flat check for unstable, you do not increase your flat check. You can spend 10 minutes re-tuning your innovation to return its functionality or you can spend 10 minutes to reduce your flat check by 4 if its functionality is already returned, up to the normal flat check value for the unstable actions you possess.”

Intro.name: Intro
Intro.text:
Foreward

This book was a special project dear to our heart because we feel that inventors carry so many awesome themes from classic literature to modern day depictions in movies and other popular media. The key focuses of this book were to bring both the flavor and mechanics needed to help certain concepts come to life in ways that were not possible before, such as being less themed by fire, more expansive use of gadgets, or simply to bring certain options and rules further in scope with the remastered version of Pathfinder Second Edition. We were ecstatic when the vote swung for Inventors and the options in this book were playtested to the highest degree, for which we are very thankful to our playtester teams for putting together such a comprehensive view of what the new options would bring the class. As always, we work tirelessly for Fam+, and this book is no exception. We hope you enjoy.

Inventors+

The work of genius is rarely appreciated to its appropriate pinnacle, as only those at the fringed peaks of innovation find themselves able to acknowledge the bravery of such endeavors. For what is invention if not the act of denial, the bold yawp against that which does not exist, the simple statement of “I will make it so.” The power of an inventor is not hinged by what is created, no, the power of the inventor is the sheer audacity to push the boundaries of the world itself, until it crumbles under its absolute authority: SCIENCE!

Inventors+ in Foundry VTT

You can find the character sheet and variants for the Inventor+ Iconic, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-iconic.Actor.lQdDZnBGLYUXCxxH]{Rutaiba El-Madjid}, within this module. Allowing you to play as her or see an example of what an Inventor made with Inventors+ may look like.

Some base innovations (such as @Compendium[pf2e.classfeatures.o70O2FysDd7BS9e0]{Construct Innovation}) do not have their modifications fully automated within the Pathfinder 2e system, in these instances you may simply drag and drop the desired modifications into your character sheet from the @UUID[.AdXm08Rsq76ln4LS]{Expanded Innovations} page.

For bug reports or inquires, please message @lyon_naglfar or @vauxs on the official Team+ discord. https://discord.com/invite/yHQbmVzDfR

New Class Feats.name: New Class Feats
New Class Feats.text:
New Traits: Theory - A theory is a conceptual imagining that you enter by using an action with the theory trait, and that you remain in for some time. A theory lasts until you get knocked out, until its requirements (if any) are violated, until the encounter ends, or until you entertain a new theory, whichever comes first. Theories progress through different phases: Predict, Test, and Analyze. These phases have stipulations on how you progress through your theory and when to change phases. After you use an action with the theory trait, you can’t use another one for 1 round. You can entertain a theory or have an ongoing theory only in encounter mode.
